text:
Maya: EvalBot flagged a spike in structured-output failures in nightly eval for new quantized model 'psi-6b-q4f' — 52 -> 210 failures vs baseline.
EvalBot: nightly/evals/2026-03-20: structured-json-parse_errors + schema_mismatch increased 4x. See sample failures.
Tom: Can you paste a representative failing output?
Maya: Sure — here's one that used to pass but now drops the "entities" field completely:
```
{"id": "q123", "answer": "Paris is the capital of France.", "entities": null}
```
Anika: Huh, earlier model returned:
```
{"id":"q123","answer":"Paris","entities":[{"type":"LOCATION","text":"Paris"}]}
```
Riley: Noticed this only after we switched PTQ path from q4f->q4_0 (quant kernel change) and enabled prefix-cache by default for nightlies.
Maya: Reproduced locally with the q4_0 artifact + prefix caching enabled. Disabling prefix cache restores correct entities.
Tom: Sounds like a cache/KV alignment issue where the structured output generator's attention window is truncated, dropping tokenized entity span.
Anika: Root cause hypothesis: PTQ kernel changed positional/attention alignment for multi-token entity spans when KV cache stride != tokenized span length. Prefix cache masks cause off-by-one in generation loop.
Maya: Quick mitigation: roll back nightly to q4f artifact and disable prefix-cache in canary until we fix. I'll open a hotfix PR to gating rules.
Riley: Also add a focused structured-output promptset to nightly eval (1000 examples) that checks presence+json parse. Gate on <=1% regression.
Tom: Action items:
- Maya: rollback nightly artifact + remove prefix-cache flag from experimental canary (ETA 1h)
- Anika: add structured-output tests to nightly and two unit tests for KV stride edgecases (ETA EOD)
- Riley: schedule a canary run with older kernel + prefix-cache toggles to narrow repro (ETA 3h)
- DevOps/DeployBot: please pin hosted canary to previous model until patch (see DeployBot message below)
DeployBot: deploy request acknowledged — pinning canary to psi-6b-q4f for hosts:canary-group. Rolling back stream in 10m. :gear:
Maya: I'll follow up with a short RCA doc after Anika's tests confirm.
Anika: If tests confirm, plan is to add a KV-cache compatibility layer in runtime and add gating rule for PTQ kernel changes.
Riley: +1 — also notify Dedicated teams; they might be auto-upgrading.
Maya: Thanks all, keeping thread updated here. :white_check_mark:
